title: Treesa-Gayatri Receive Historic World Championships Bronze Medal
indian_angle: Indian women's doubles pair Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand achieved a historic bronze medal at the World Championships.
summary: The unseeded Indian pair of Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand received their bronze medal at the World Championships, following their semifinal loss to China’s Liu-Tan and a quarterfinal victory over Jia Yifan and Zhang Shuxian.

title: India Open to Relocate to Guwahati in 2028
indian_angle: The prestigious India Open Super 750 tournament, a key event for Indian badminton, is set to move its venue to Guwahati in 2028.
summary: The 2028 India Open Super 750 badminton tournament will be held in Guwahati, marking a significant change for the event.

title: Badminton's Evolving Game: Power and Endurance Dominates
indian_angle: Indian players, like their international counterparts, are increasingly adapting to the sport's global shift towards more physical and aggressive play.
summary: Experts analyze how badminton has evolved into a high-speed, physical grinder, moving away from traditional finesse and deception.
